app.title: Khleng Ek
app.subtitle: The humming kite festival
app.tagline: Fly a humming Khmer kite over rice fields, temples and the full-moon festival, across 120 levels and an endless sky.

home.how1: Drag anywhere on the screen to steer the kite: it follows your finger. Or use the arrow keys.
home.how2: Dodge egrets, rival kites, bunting and storm clouds. Three knocks and the line snaps.
home.how3: Fly through rings and collect coins, then spend them in the workshop on power-ups and new kite designs.

paddies.name: Rice Fields
paddies.blurb: Green paddies after the harvest, and egrets everywhere.

palms.name: Sugar Palms
palms.blurb: Rows of tall palms: fly over their crowns, not into them.

tonlesap.name: Tonle Sap
tonlesap.blurb: Wide water, fishing boats and gusty winds off the lake.

angkor.name: Angkor
angkor.blurb: Ancient towers in the golden evening light.

palace.name: Royal Palace
palace.blurb: The festival sky over the capital, full of kites.

moon.name: Full Moon
moon.blurb: The night festival: sky lanterns rise under the moon.

tips.ring: Fly right through the middle of each ring: every one is worth ten coins.
tips.bird: Egrets fly across the sky: wait for them to pass, or go over.
tips.rival: Rival kites hang on lines down to the ground: go round the line, or over the kite.
tips.bunting: Bunting stretches right across the sky: fly above it or below it.
tips.cloud: Storm clouds sit high up: stay low to pass them.
tips.palm: Sugar palms stand tall: fly above their crowns.
tips.lantern: Sky lanterns drift up from below: keep high.

game.noWebgl: This device can't show the 3D sky (WebGL is off or not supported).

hints.drag: Drag anywhere to steer the kite.
hints.lives: Three knocks snap the line: dodge everything!
hints.rings: Fly through the middle of the rings.

result.banked: Your coins are saved for the workshop.

workshop.title: Workshop
workshop.startShieldText: Every flight starts with a shield on.

intro.0: The harvest is in, Dara. Do you know what that means?
intro.1: Kite season! Can I fly the khleng ek you made, Grandpa?
intro.2: Hold the line gently. Listen: when the ek hums, the wind is with you.

intro.0: Grandpa, the sugar palms are so tall here!
intro.1: Fly above their crowns. A kite in a palm tree stays there till the rains.

intro.0: The wind off the Tonle Sap is strong and full of tricks.
intro.2: Don't fight it. Lean into it, and the ek will sing louder.

intro.0: Angkor! The towers look like lotus buds.
intro.1: People have flown kites here for hundreds of years.
intro.2: Then my kite will fly here too.

intro.0: The festival in the capital. Every kite in the country is here!
intro.1: So many lines in the sky. How will I get through?
intro.2: Watch where each line goes down to the ground, and keep clear of it.

intro.0: Grandpa, a kite at night? Under the full moon?
intro.1: It's the best time. The air is calm, and the lanterns rise with you.
intro.2: Then listen, everyone: here comes my ek!

outro.0: Every sky, from the paddies to the full moon. I heard your ek from the village.
outro.1: It sings because you made it well, Grandpa.
outro.2: Next season, you'll make your own. And the endless sky is still waiting.
